description:
Goal: Make runtime allocation lifetime assertions correct under ordinary parallel runtime tests, preserving their destruction/refcount/layout guarantees and removing proven-unused production counter work. This is a discovered prerequisite, not permission to serialize the runtime suite or weaken assertions.

Signal: fz-tfn.49 final default-parallel runtime gate failed heap::heap_test::alloc_procbin_pushes_into_mso_chain_with_strict_layout at runtime/src/heap/heap_test.rs1615: global live_count1 versus baseline0. Original failure /tmp/fz-tfn49-runtime.log (209 pass/1 fail) is retained. Exact isolated test /tmp/fz-tfn49-runtime-isolated.log and full serial runtime /tmp/fz-tfn49-runtime-serial.log pass1/1 and210/210. Runtime and Cargo files are unchanged by49. Source-proven competing allocators include unannotated heap::alloc_stats_record_heap_allocations_by_kind (heap_test.rs57–71, c81723c2f6) and any_value::heap_object_refs_clear_addresses_before_projection (any_value.rs452–466, dee5068360), each allocating a >64-byte SharedBin while the serial_test-marked lifetime test can run. The unannotated any_value test also allocates Resource while resource_test.rs uses an analogous process-global LiveCountGuard, exposing the same known isolation defect. Resource production allocation/immediate and deferred release update a gauge whose sole getter is also cfg(test). Treat both known instances in this cutover; fixing only SharedBin leaves the same runtime gate hazard. The log does not identify which allocation overlapped historically; the interleaving is nevertheless reachable and demonstrates an invalid global-observation authority.

Research: SharedBin LIVE_COUNT in runtime/src/procbin.rs155 is process-global. Its getter is cfg(test), but shared_bin_alloc and shared_bin_destructor_heap perform production atomic updates; verify no production reader before removing that unused work. SharedBin is repr(C), exactly40 bytes, with a per-allocation destructor pointer; ProcBin is16 bytes. Preserve ABI, cross-thread final-release semantics, static no-op destructor behavior, actual heap buffer reclamation and loom ordering tests. Do not substitute a narrower fake destruction test for actual ownership proof.

Strategy: TDD with a deterministic coordinated interleaving, no sleeps or probabilistic rerun-to-green. Establish the smallest exact per-owner/allocation lifetime observation using existing ownership/destructor boundaries. Retain parallelism; no blanket serial locks, subprocess-per-test workaround, global test registry/scanner, budgets, retries or ignored assertions. Main agent must inspect applicable docs and acceptance before implementation. Independent read-only diagnosis completed: exact-object SharedBinHandle witnesses can keep the observed pointer valid while asserting heap-owned reference removal (2 to1; shared heaps3 to2 to1). Pair those with existing exactly-once destructor tests: a retained witness alone does not establish final destruction. Resource already supplies a payload/destructor seam suitable for a per-test observer. No new production field, ABI layout, global registry, or duplicate ownership authority is needed. Preserve immediate and deferred Resource destruction semantics. All ten open PR file inventories were inspected; none changes runtime/.

Acceptance: Prove independent concurrent allocators cannot contaminate each other; the tested allocation is destroyed exactly once, including cross-thread last release, sharing, GC, heap drop and static cases currently covered. Remove obsolete global gauge/guards/annotations when superseded, with no construction debris or duplicate observation authority. Default-parallel full runtime suite must pass; existing compiler/artifact/ABI semantics and healthy work budgets remain unchanged. Run relevant compiler, runtime, fixture/CLI/AOT/doc/format/strict-clippy gates in proportion to production scope; fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review, one commit/close and CI-gated push. Duplicate search across all bw tickets for live_count, SharedBin, alloc_procbin and runtime parallel found no existing issue.

Placement: Blocks landing49 because its required default-parallel runtime gate failed.49 source/tests/docs are frozen and cold-accepted, but its measurement/full acceptance is not closed. Park49 safely before this prerequisite implementation; preserve its hashes/evidence and restore only after this ticket lands, then reverify the combined branch. Also blocks final39 epic acceptance. No source modification or claim of successful fix has occurred yet.
